query:
SELECT r.id, r.name, r.category
FROM recettes r
LEFT JOIN molecules_recettes mr ON r.id = mr.recette_id
WHERE (r.name LIKE '%Volcanique%' OR r.name LIKE '%Fumé%' OR r.name LIKE '%Pyrolyse%' OR r.category = 'tabac')
GROUP BY r.id
HAVING COUNT(mr.molecule_id) = 0
LIMIT 50;
